title: Consolidate the duplicate 0-indexed/1-indexed level-value accessors in content_grouping.dart

evidence.quote:
String? _levelValueAt(ContentItem item, int depth) => switch (depth) {
  0 => item.level1,

String? levelValueAt(ContentItem item, int level) => switch (level) {
  1 => item.level1,

why: Two functions differing only by a leading underscore implement the identical level1..level4 switch, one 0-indexed (internal, used by groupItemsByNextLevel) and one 1-indexed (public, used by hierarchy_browser.dart and hierarchy_selection_panel.dart). The near-identical names with different index conventions is exactly the kind of thing a future edit touches in one copy and forgets in the other, or a caller picks the wrong one and is off by one level.
recommendation: Keep only the public 1-indexed levelValueAt and have groupItemsByNextLevel call it with `depth + 1`, deleting the private 0-indexed twin.
acceptance_criteria: content_grouping.dart has one level-value accessor function, not two.
coarse_unit_leaf_refs_test.dart and existing grouping behavior are unchanged.
